note: Campground in the Ottawa Lake Recreation Area, with a swim beach and boat launch on Ottawa Lake; the west loop's sites sit in woods above the shore. Walk-in tent sites and an accessible cabin are part of the campground; the Horseriders' Campground elsewhere in the unit is separate (horse campers only). --Claude
summary: DNR camping page + 2026 campground map read: 100 sites (65 electric), showers, flush + vault toilets, water, dump; only year-round campground in the Southern Unit (limited plowed sites in winter); reservations required. Lakeview kept (west-loop spurs 20-35 m from the shore through continuous woods; the stored 'open grassy band' evidence is wrong). Pin is at the entrance station, ~265 m from the loops - re-pin. Fees, amps and per-site lengths unread (GoingToCamp refuses).
